name: Haritha Hotel Laknavaram Restaurant
signature_dish: Indian meals with a Laknavaram Lake view
why_it_matters: The restaurant at the Telangana tourism (TSTDC) Haritha resort on Laknavaram Lake — by every account the only restaurant within about a kilometre of the lake. Reached across the lake's famous suspension bridge, it is effectively the single dining option at this remote Govindaraopet-mandal lake, around 70km from Warangal.
insider_tip: There is no alternative right at the lake — plan to eat here, and don't arrive expecting a choice of restaurants. Standard Indian menu; the lake view from the resort is the draw. Booking ahead is wise on weekends and holidays.
signature_address: Telangana Tourism Haritha Hotel, Laknavaram Lake, Govindaraopet mandal, Mulugu District, Telangana 506345

name: Feriado Resorts Tadvai Restaurant
signature_dish: Resort-kitchen meals in the Tadvai forest belt
why_it_matters: The restaurant at Feriado Resorts in Tadvai — repeatedly described by guests as the only decent hotel for some 45km in either direction. In the forested Mulugu belt that surrounds Laknavaram, it is one of the very few proper kitchens, serving resort meals to travellers exploring the lakes, waterfalls and trails.
insider_tip: Menu options are limited but the food quality is well-rated — order what is available rather than expecting a long card. As one of the only kitchens for miles, time meals around its service hours. Booking ahead is advisable.
signature_address: Feriado Resorts, Tadvai village, Mulugu District, Telangana 506344

name: Hotel Royal Plaza
signature_dish: Biryani and Indian meals in Mulugu town
why_it_matters: A hotel-restaurant on Mulugu Main Road in Mulugu town — the district headquarters and the nearest proper town to Laknavaram Lake. Listed here as a base-town option, since Laknavaram itself has only the lakeside Haritha restaurant.
insider_tip: A Mulugu base-town pick — useful if you are staying or passing through Mulugu town rather than at the lake. Standard Indian and biryani menu. Walk-in.
signature_address: Mulugu Main Road, opposite DLR Function Hall, Mulugu town, Mulugu District, Telangana 506343

name: Haritha Grand Mulugu Restaurant
why_it_matters: The restaurant at Haritha Grand, a Telangana-tourism-branded resort hotel at Jakaram near Mulugu town — a spacious, well-rated property serving in-house meals. A reliable base-town dining option for travellers staying near Mulugu while visiting Laknavaram, Ramappa and the Medaram circuit.
insider_tip: A Mulugu-area base option with a comfortable restaurant — handy if Royal Plaza is full. Multi-cuisine resort menu. The same Haritha Grand brand also runs properties at Medaram and Gattamma for the Sammakka Saralamma circuit.
signature_address: Haritha Grand, Jakaram village, Mulugu mandal, Mulugu District, Telangana 506343
